english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the act or service of cutting hair.
This is the everyday noun for a haircut or haircut touch-up.
Use this for the haircut as an activity or service.

examples.english: I’m going for a haircut tomorrow.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 heoi3 zin2 faat3

examples.english: I’m going for a trim today; I’m only taking a little off.
examples.traditional: 我今日去剪髮，淨係修短少少。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 heoi3 zin2 faat3 zing6 hai6 sau1 dyun2 siu2 siu2
